title: Siege of Erivan (1635)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Erivan (1635)", at revision 1371427363, opens: "The siege of Erivan was a military engagement of the Ottoman–Safavid War (1623–1639). During this siege, the Ottoman Empire occupied the city of Erivan" That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q31070845, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1635 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
